comment: A review commit is scoped by the Jira key, so a spec-catchup run under that key can write behaviour outside the theme's footprint. derive-scenarios excludes those by default and reports them as outsideFootprint. Where a human has judged one to be the theme's behaviour after all, it is listed here and counted. Anything not listed stays excluded, so the default is conservative and every inclusion is a recorded decision.

plants/journey-pages/place-of-destinatio: Save and return to overview with nothing chosen reaches Overview without an error

live-animals/journey-pages/check-your-an: The port of exit row reads the option the user chose
The port of entry row reads the port's name, a dash and its code
A territory destination country is named with its country
plants/journey-obligations/origin/spec.m: A territory is accepted where its country is allowed
A territory is refused where its country is not allowed
plants/journey-pages/check-your-answers/: The place of landing row reads the option the user chose
A territory of origin is named with its country
plants/notification-dashboard/spec.md: A territory of origin is named with its country on the card

judged.2026-10-14: reference-lists: of ten scenarios its review commit wrote outside the footprint, eight are the country and port list change reaching the review, the plants origin obligations and the dashboard card, and are included. Two are not reference-lists behaviour at all and stay out: the confirmation page's date of notification, and the dashboard's submitted date for a late-evening submission. Both are timezone handling swept in by the same spec-catchup. journey-foundation: its one excluded scenario is inc-003's save-and-return-to-overview behaviour on another plants page, so it is included.
